name: Brothers ~Koi Suru Onii-sama~
original_name: ブラザーズ～恋するお兄さま～
source:
The protagonist Nanase Suzuna is a very normal college student. Her father died when she was a child, but suddenly one day her mother introduced her to the person she was going to get remarried to. Because of her mother's happy smile and how nice her new father seemed Suzuna approved of the marriage and she prepared to move into her new fathers house but...

On the day of the move, at the imposing gated mansion, she learned that her new father had four sons! Suzuna was shocked! More than that, her mother and new father were going away for a week and leaving her to live alone with her four new brothers (and their servant Kageyama) under the same roof.

Then Suzuna received a proposal from those brothers.
    "If you can make us approve of you as our little sister within one week, we'll bless those two's marriage."
She hoped for her parent's happiness so Suzuna happily accepted but...
In truth the brothers already objected to the marriage, little did Suzuna know but to them this was just the start of another game.
    "How about we bet on which one of us brothers Suzuna will fall for first?"

It's one week until her father and mother come back, will Suzuna be able to protect herself!?
Will she be able to build sibling bonds with her new brothers!?
What is the true nature of Kageyama who is always watching over the five of them!?

Now this skillfully dangerous battle of one little sister VS four big brothers + one man will start――!

[Translated from the official site]
translation:
主人公七濑铃菜是一名非常普通的大学生。父亲在她年幼时去世。某天，母亲突然把准备再婚的对象介绍给了她。母亲脸上的幸福笑容和新父亲温和的为人令铃菜赞成这桩婚事，她也开始准备搬进新父亲的家。然而…

搬家当天，铃菜来到一座大门森严的豪宅，才得知新父亲竟然有四个儿子！她大吃一惊！更糟的是，母亲与新父亲要外出整整一周，让她与四名新哥哥（以及佣人影山）独自在同一屋檐下生活。

随后，兄弟们向铃菜提出一个条件。
    “如果你能在一周内让我们承认你这个妹妹，我们就祝福他们结婚。”
为了父母的幸福，铃菜欣然接受，可是…
实际上，四兄弟早已反对这桩婚事。铃菜并不知道，对他们来说，这不过是另一场游戏的开始。
    “不如赌一赌，看我们兄弟中谁会先让铃菜爱上自己？”

距离父母回来还有一周，铃菜能保护好自己吗！？
她能与新的哥哥们建立兄妹情谊吗！？
始终守望着五人的影山，真实身份究竟是什么！？

一名妹妹对四名哥哥加一个男人，这场高明而危险的战斗如今正式开始——！

[翻译自官方网站]
